name: Game Exporter
author: PolyKit
description: Builds honest Unity and Unreal import bundles while keeping the mesh available for downstream workflow nodes.

zh-CN.name: 游戏引擎导出
zh-CN.description: 生成 Unity 与 Unreal 导入包，同时保留可继续处理的网格主输出。

en-US.name: Game Exporter
en-US.description: Builds honest Unity and Unreal import bundles while keeping the mesh available for downstream workflow nodes.

nodes.name: Unity Import Bundle
nodes.description: Packages the mesh under Assets/PolyKit with a Unity .meta file and importer guidance. FBX/OBJ use Unity's built-in model importer; glTF needs a glTF package.

params_schema.label: Asset Folder
params_schema.tooltip: Project-relative folder inside the Unity bundle.

params_schema.label: Include Readme
params_schema.tooltip: Include concise import instructions and capability limits.

nodes.name: Unreal Import Bundle
nodes.description: Packages the mesh under Content/PolyKit with Unreal import settings and a repeatable import manifest. Unreal still performs the final editor import and asset cooking.

params_schema.label: Content Folder
params_schema.tooltip: Project-relative folder inside the Unreal bundle.

params_schema.label: Include Readme
params_schema.tooltip: Include concise import instructions and capability limits.

params_schema.label: Auto Collision
params_schema.tooltip: Request auto-generated collision in the Unreal import settings manifest.
